storageDescription: Review disk use and reclaim space from Kandev-owned workspaces, caches, and Docker resources whenever your installation needs it.
storageSectionUnavailable: This storage section could not be loaded
storageAdoptionPending: Wait for Go cache adoption to finish.
storagePolicyLoadingBlock: Wait for storage settings to finish loading.
storageActionPending: Wait for the current storage action to finish.
storageActionsDescription: Analyze for a read-only snapshot, or run the enabled cleanup rules when you want to recover space immediately.
storageBusyTitle: Storage cleanup found active Kandev work
storageBusyIntro: Cleanup may disrupt the following work:
storageBusyForceHint: Running cleanup anyway may disrupt this active work.
storageAnalysisDescription: A read-only breakdown of current usage and reclaimable space. Run Analyze occasionally to refresh these estimates; it never deletes or moves anything.
storageWorkspacesDetail: {{reclaimable}} reclaimable after the grace period · {{active}} active
storageQuarantineUnmeasured: Quarantine usage could not be measured
storageQuarantineMovedAside_one: {{count}} item moved aside for recovery before permanent deletion
storageQuarantineMovedAside_other: {{count}} items moved aside for recovery before permanent deletion
storageDockerUnmeasured: Docker usage could not be measured
storageUnusedImagesDetail: Unused by every container and older than the configured age
storageGoCacheNotOwned: Only a Kandev-owned Go build cache can be cleaned.
storageGoCacheBelowLimit: The Go build cache is below its configured size limit.
storagePolicyDescription: Choose what Kandev may reclaim automatically and the safety limits it must follow.
storageScheduleDescription: Controls when automatic maintenance is allowed to start. Manual actions remain available when scheduling is off.
storageScheduledMaintenanceDescription: Periodically reclaim disk space using the enabled resource rules.
storageScheduledMaintenanceHelp: When enabled, Kandev checks this policy at the configured interval and starts only after Kandev has been idle for the required period. Turning it off does not disable Analyze or Run now.
storageCheckIntervalHelp: How often Kandev checks whether scheduled maintenance is due. A check that finds Kandev busy is skipped and tried again at the next interval.
storageIdleHelp: Scheduled cleanup starts only after no task, shell command, test, setup, cleanup, or image build has used managed resources for this long. Run now does not wait for this timer, but it still refuses to run while resources are active.
storageWorkspacesDescription: Reclaim resources that Kandev can positively identify as no longer in use.
storageOrphanWorkspacesDescription: Move confirmed orphan workspaces to quarantine.
storageOrphanWorkspacesHelp: Kandev only selects a task workspace after inventory confirms that no active task, environment, session, or protected worktree uses it. The workspace is moved to quarantine first, where it can be restored before permanent deletion.
storageOrphanGraceHelp: A workspace must be unused for at least this long before it can be classified as an orphan. Increasing this value keeps old workspaces longer before they enter quarantine.
storageContainersDescription: Remove stopped, unused containers created and labeled by Kandev.
storageContainersHelp: Only stopped containers labeled as Kandev-managed are considered, and inventory must confirm they are no longer needed. Running containers and unrelated Docker containers are never removed by this option.
storageGoCacheSectionDescription: Use and trim a Kandev-owned cache for new host-local executions.
storageManagedGoCacheHelp: When enabled, Kandev gives new local task processes a dedicated Go build cache and may rotate it during maintenance when it exceeds the maximum. Turning this off stops using the managed cache for new executions but does not delete it.
storageGoCacheMaxHelp: This is a cleanup trigger, not a hard quota. The cache may grow past this size while tasks are active. Maintenance rotates the owned cache into quarantine and recreates an empty cache after the limit is exceeded.
storageExternalGoCacheHelp: Adoption gives Kandev explicit permission to rotate this existing cache. Kandev never cleans a default user cache or another path unless you adopt that exact absolute path and confirm the destructive access.
storageExternalGoCacheDescription: Optionally allow Kandev to maintain an existing host cache outside its managed path.
storageEnableGoCacheFirst: Enable the managed Go cache first.
storageEnterCachePathFirst: Enter an absolute cache path first.
storageDockerDescription: Optional daemon-wide cleanup. Enable it only when this Docker daemon is dedicated to Kandev.
storageDockerUnavailable: Docker is unavailable on the configured host.
storageDockerUnavailableNotice: Docker is unavailable; Docker cleanup options cannot run on this host.
storageAcknowledgeDedicatedFirst: Acknowledge a dedicated Docker daemon first.
storageDedicatedDaemonDescription: Confirm that unrelated workloads do not share this Docker daemon.
storageDedicatedDaemonHelp: Build cache and image ownership cannot be attributed reliably to Kandev. This acknowledgment unlocks daemon-wide cleanup and should only be enabled when the configured Docker daemon is used exclusively by Kandev. Kandev never performs a volume-wide prune.
storageDockerBuildCacheDescription: Remove old build cache while retaining the configured amount.
storageDockerBuildCacheHelp: Uses Docker's age and storage filters to remove old build cache. It does not run docker system prune, does not remove volumes globally, and remains disabled until the dedicated-daemon acknowledgment is confirmed.
storageBuildCacheKeepHelp: Docker keeps approximately this much build cache when pruning eligible records. A larger value preserves more reusable build layers but reclaims less disk space.
storageBuildCacheUnusedLabel: Build cache must be unused for (hours)
storageBuildCacheUnusedHelp: Only build cache records older than this unused-age threshold are eligible. Increasing it protects recent build layers for longer.
storageUnusedImagesDescription: Remove old images that no container uses.
storageUnusedImagesHelp: Removes an image only when no running or stopped container references it and it is older than the configured age. This is daemon-wide and therefore requires the dedicated-daemon acknowledgment.
storageUnusedImagesHoursHelp: An image must be unused by every container and older than this age before Kandev can remove it. Increasing the value keeps old images available for longer.
storageQuarantineSafetyDescription: Keep recoverable resources for a grace period before permanent deletion.
storageQuarantineRetentionHelp: Cleanup first moves orphan workspaces and rotated Go caches into Kandev's trash area instead of deleting them immediately. During this retention period you can restore an item. After the deadline, a later maintenance run may permanently delete it.
storageDedicatedDialogDescription: Build-cache and unused-image cleanup affect the entire configured daemon, including resources created outside Kandev. Only acknowledge a daemon dedicated to this installation.
storageAdoptDialogTitle: Adopt an external Go build cache
storageAdoptDialogDescription: Kandev will be allowed to rotate and quarantine the existing cache at {{path}}. This path must be absolute and on the same filesystem as Kandev trash.
storageDeleteDialogDescription: This cannot be undone. Kandev will permanently remove {{path}}.
storagePurgeEligibleCount_one: This will permanently remove {{count}} eligible item.
storagePurgeEligibleCount_other: This will permanently remove {{count}} eligible items.
storagePurgeProtectedCount_one: {{count}} protected item remains until its retention deadline.
storagePurgeProtectedCount_other: {{count}} protected items remain until their retention deadlines.
storageForceClearDescription: This attempts to permanently remove every quarantined item immediately and cannot be undone for entries that succeed. Failed entries may remain visible and retryable.
storageQuarantineHelp: Quarantine is Kandev's recoverable holding area. Orphan task workspaces and rotated Go caches are moved here before deletion. You can restore an item during its retention period; after the deadline, a later maintenance run may permanently delete it.
storageQuarantineCardDescription: Cleanup moves recoverable data here first instead of deleting it immediately. Restore an item if you still need it, or delete it permanently when you are certain.
storageQuarantineScheduleOn_one: Eligible entries are removed by the first successful maintenance run after their deadline (every {{count}} hour when the idle gate allows it).
storageQuarantineScheduleOn_other: Eligible entries are removed by the first successful maintenance run after their deadline (every {{count}} hours when the idle gate allows it).
storageQuarantineScheduleOff: Automatic quarantine cleanup is off. Run maintenance manually or use a quarantine action when you are ready.
storageNoEligibleEntries: No quarantine entries are eligible yet.
storageQuarantineCleanupRunning: A quarantine cleanup is still running.
